description: This file is the main include script for the ADODB database abstraction library in PHP. It defines constants, global variables, helper functions, and core classes such as ADOConnection for database connectivity and operations. The code provides a comprehensive set of methods for executing queries, managing transactions, caching, and retrieving database metadata, facilitating database independence and ease of use across different database systems.

classes.name: ADOFieldObject
classes.description: Helper class representing a database table column with properties such as name, max_length, and type.

classes.name: ADOConnection
classes.description: Core class for managing database connections and executing SQL queries, including transaction handling, caching, and metadata retrieval.

classes.name: ADOFetchObj
classes.description: Internal placeholder for record objects. Used by ADORecordSet->FetchObj().

classes.name: ADORecordSet_empty
classes.description: Lightweight recordset when there are no records to be returned

classes.name: ADORecordSet
classes.description: RecordSet class that represents the dataset returned by the database. It holds only the current row in memory, supports fetching, navigation, and data access.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array
classes.description: Encapsulates a recordset created in memory as a 2D array, useful for cached recordsets, with methods to initialize from an array and access data.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database with specified host, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement or prepared statement, returning a recordset or success indicator.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Starts a database transaction.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all rows resulting from a query as an array.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Returns the first value of the first row from a query, disposing of the recordset afterward.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Generates SQL to offset a date by a specified fraction of days.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Returns metadata about columns of a specified table as an array of ADOFieldObject.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Lists indexes on a table as an array, typically returning index name, uniqueness, and columns involved.

methods.name: MetaColumnNames
methods.description: Lists the column names in a table as an array.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Provides a wrapper for concatenating strings using the database-specific operator.

methods.name: DBDate
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp or date string into a database-understandable date string.

methods.name: BindDate
methods.description: Converts a date string to a format suitable for binding in SQL queries.

methods.name: BindTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a database-understandable string.

methods.name: DBTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp or date string into a database timestamp string.

methods.name: UnixDate
methods.description: Converts a date string (YYYY-MM-DD) into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: UnixTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) into a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: UserDate
methods.description: Formats a database date string into user-defined formats.

methods.name: UserTimeStamp
methods.description: Formats a database timestamp string into user-defined formats.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: addq
methods.description: Quotes a string without including surrounding quotes, handling quote escaping.

methods.name: qstr
methods.description: Quotes and escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries, including surrounding quotes.

methods.name: PageExecute
methods.description: Performs a paginated query and returns a recordset for a specific page.

methods.name: CachePageExecute
methods.description: Performs a paginated query with caching options.

methods.name: GetMenu
methods.description: Generates an HTML select menu from a recordset.

methods.name: GetMenu2
methods.description: Generates an HTML select menu from a recordset, treating the second column as the display text.

methods.name: GetMenu3
methods.description: Generates a grouped HTML select menu.

methods.name: GetArray
methods.description: Returns the current recordset as a 2D array.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all records as a 2D array.

methods.name: NextRecordSet
methods.description: Advances to the next recordset, if multiple result sets are returned.

methods.name: GetArrayLimit
methods.description: Returns a subset of the recordset as an array, starting from a specified offset.

methods.name: GetRows
methods.description: Alias for GetArray, for compatibility.

methods.name: GetAssoc
methods.description: Returns the recordset as an associative array, keyed by the first column.

methods.name: FetchRow
methods.description: Fetches the current row as an array, moving the internal pointer.

methods.name: FetchInto
methods.description: Fetches the current row into an existing array.

methods.name: MoveFirst
methods.description: Moves cursor to the first row.

methods.name: MoveLast
methods.description: Moves cursor to the last row.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Moves cursor to the next row.

methods.name: Move
methods.description: Moves to a specific row number.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Returns the value of a field in the current row by column name.

methods.name: FieldCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the recordset.

methods.name: RecordCount
methods.description: Returns number of records or -1 if not supported.

methods.name: RowCount
methods.description: Alias for RecordCount.

methods.name: AbsolutePosition
methods.description: Returns the current row position (0-based).

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and frees the recordset.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Returns a standardized type code ('C','X','B','N','D','T','L','I','R') for a database column type.
